note: The futures league (퓨처스리그) of a league of one division (docs/08 R8-1): as the KBO's in 2026, twelve teams in two leagues of six — each club's second team, and two teams of their own (the armed forces' team and a city's). The names are changed the way the clubs' are (the user, 2026-11-22: real names cleverly changed): a club's second team is its club's name with 2군, except where the real one has a name of its own (a club id in 'names'). 'games' is a season's games for a 144-game first-team season, scaled with the season's length. 'level' is how far an independent team's players are above (or below) a second team's usual level, in rating points. Clubs of the league not listed in north or south (a fictional league) are split between the two.
